item.title: Ajax snatch draw at AZ with stoppage-time equalizer
item.description: A late equalizing goal from Kian Fitz-Jim rescued a point for Ajax on Sunday away to AZ Alkmaar.

item.title: PSV win again while NEC stay in Feyenoord’s wake
item.description: PSV picked up a hard-fought victory away to FC Groningen on Sunday to maintain their 14-point lead at the top of the Eredivisie table.

item.title: Rotterdam metro to The Hague to run every five minutes by 2033
item.description: The Rotterdam metro between Rotterdam and The Hague will run every five minutes on weekdays starting in 2033, city and regional officials said. Currently, trains run every ten minutes.

item.title: ABN AMRO warns 2028 Box 3 tax could penalize investors despite no real gains
item.description: ABN AMRO wealth experts Tjarko Denekamp and Peter Beets say the Dutch government’s plan to overhaul the Box 3 wealth tax raises legal and practical concerns.

item.title: Feyenoord asks Utrecht to explain police's harsh treatment of fans
item.description: Feyenoord will ask the municipality of Utrecht for clarification on Monday about how the police treated the Rotterdam football club’s fans on Sunday afternoon.

item.title: Well-meaning payment pause for tax debts left benefit scandal victims in more trouble
item.description: In 2021, the government decided to give the victims in the benefits scandal a break by temporarily suspending their payments to the Tax Authority and the Child Benefits Agency.
